title: Lake Ocoee Inn & Marina

services.name: Kayak rental
services.desc: Parksville Lake (also known as Lake Ocoee) has over 1,900 acres of surface water with 47 miles of shoreline and is a perfect destination for the first time or experienced kayaker. You can rent a variety of kayaks from Lake Ocoee Inn & Marina and immediately enjoy the scenic beauty of Parksville Lake. Nestled in the mountains of the Cherokee National Forest, Lake Ocoee is a 20 minute drive from nearby Cleveland, TN. If you are traveling on Interstate 75 (I-75) it is a short 20 mile drive from either Exit 20 or Exit 25. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Pontoon boats accommodate parties of up to 10 or 15 depending on the specific boat and are perfect for family outings or group picnics. Pontoons are 1/2 covered providing some shielding from direct sun and come equipped with a ladder and comfortable seating for a day on the lake. All renters must be 21 years of age and present a valid state boating license. Boat Reservations require payment in full for requested rental time including tax. Upon arrival a cash damage deposit will be due for each boat reserved. Rates exclude gas, oil and tax. Rental fees are due up front.
